rules.title: Block unsafe child companion launch
rules.explanation: An under-thirteen conversational experience without human oversight, notice, and completed safety evaluation is prohibited.

rules.title: Block autonomous employment termination
rules.explanation: A fully autonomous employment termination decision without human review or appeal is prohibited.

rules.title: Escalate high-impact automated decisions
rules.explanation: Automated decisions affecting employment, credit, health, education, or account access require authorized human approval.

rules.title: Escalate biometric identity decisions
rules.explanation: Biometric identity verification affecting account access requires privacy and jurisdiction-specific approval.

rules.title: Require missing launch safeguards
rules.explanation: Missing notice, incomplete safety evaluation, unresolved questions, or other blocking controls must be remediated before launch.

rules.title: Require enhanced minor safeguards
rules.explanation: A teen or all-ages AI experience requires completed age-appropriate safeguards before launch.

rules.title: Require sensitive data approval
rules.explanation: Sensitive or biometric data processing with unresolved approval questions requires remediation before launch.

rules.title: Allow adequately controlled low-risk launch
rules.explanation: No deny, escalation, or material-gap rule was triggered and the documented safeguards support launch.
